proposalSummary: In `ICDMapper.read_mapping_file` (`icd_mapper.py`), keep the warning naming file and data-row number but recover the row instead of dropping it: if `len(row) < 8`, pad with `''` to length 8 (`row += [''] * (8 - len(row))`) and continue normal extraction. Missing trailing fields thus become `''` -> `

opened.title: Characterisation tests never assert that a short row is kept, so this recovery can regress without a red build.

attempts.detail: The change can create mappings with blank required fields (for example rows with fewer than five columns become entries with an empty ICD-10-AM code), risking invalid mappings in output.

Rows with only five to seven fields but both code columns present are now accepted even though non-optional trailing data such as the ICD-10-AM descriptor may have been genuinely truncated, producing mappings with silently blanked fields.

The padding path cannot recover any short row because column 7 (ICD-10-AM descriptor) is mandatory, so every row with fewer than 8 fields is still skipped; the stated improvement therefore does not work.
Recover short mapping rows whose omitted trailing columns are optional
